title: CSV column contract (schema-of-schemas)
description: Validates datasets/data/_schema/columns.json - the one machine-readable home for the per-file-class CSV column contract. Spec: docs/architecture/data/csv-column-contract.md (D-DOC0). Consumed by the backend write-time validator (B1.3), the frontend typed-read codegen (F1), and the cross-format drift test.

x-changelog.description: Initial sub-plan B1.1 schema for the columns.json artifact. Mirrors csv-column-contract.md sections 2-4: file-class keyed by canonical-tree glob; per-column {name, dtype, nullable, pk?, fk?, enum?, derived?}; closed-enum membership; no second hand-typed column-name copy permitted.

Companion bump for columns.json $schema_version 1.0 -> 1.1 (PR-0 of TODO/20260610-electoral-data-quality-and-party-catalogue-plan.md). No structural change to the schema-of-schemas itself; pure-additive minor on the data file: 10 nullable identity-metadata columns appended to the datasets/data/entities/parties.csv file-class (recognition_scope, home_state_codes, founded_year, dissolved_year, predecessor_party_ids, successor_party_ids, name_history, claims_to_parent_name, name_native_script, is_sentinel) per Hans + Gregor Wave 0 verdict (plan section 2.1). Existing rows unchanged in shape; 3 sentinel rows (parties.IN.UNK / parties.IN.IND / parties.IN.NOTA) lifted from adapter hardcodes into the CSV so FK closure now includes them (Hans Wave 0 / section 2.1).

file_class_glob.description: Glob over the canonical tree, anchored at repo root. POSIX separators only. No double-underscore in any path segment (plan section 21.6).

columns.description: Columns in EMISSION order. The CSV header MUST equal this list (no reordering, no extras, no omissions) per csv-column-contract.md section 2.

notes.description: Human-readable note carried alongside the file-class entry. Not consumed by the validator; surfaced in tooling output.

dtype.description: CSV-readable dtype. Maps 1:1 to a DuckDB read_csv() column type.

nullable.description: Whether the column may carry NULL. The writer rejects NULL on a non-nullable column; the validator rejects empty-string-on-nullable=false.

pk.description: Member of the primary key for this file class. Composite PKs declare pk:true on each member. Rows are sorted deterministically by the PK before write.

fk.description: Foreign-key target as '<file-class-glob>.<column>'. Enforced by the B1.3 validator.

enum.description: Closed-enum membership (single source per csv-column-contract.md section 4). The validator rejects values outside the set.

derived.description: F7 computed at write time, never hand-authored. The writer rejects callers that supply the column in input rows.
